description.en: Detects HTML download pages and rewrites the URL to the archive link they reference.
description.zh: 识别 HTML 下载页面并改写到页面里指向的压缩包链接。

en: Inspects a URL before the task is created
Detects when the target is an HTML landing page instead of a file
Rewrites the task to the first archive or installer link on the page (.zip, .tar.gz, .tgz, .rar, .7z, .exe, .dmg, .iso, .pkg)
Configurable page-scan size limit; direct file links are never touched
zh: 在任务创建前检查 URL
识别目标是 HTML 落地页而非文件的情况
自动改写为页面中第一个压缩包或安装包直链（.zip、.tar.gz、.tgz、.rar、.7z、.exe、.dmg、.iso、.pkg）
可配置扫描页面体积上限；文件直链不受影响
